title: ClickHouse backup take/restore: cross-node via the shared NFS repository
description: The nexus-cli backup verb (take + restore) for ClickHouse: BACKUP a table TO Disk('analytics_backups', ...) on one node and RESTORE it from a DIFFERENT node, proving the repository is genuinely cluster-shared (NFS from nexus-gateway, ADR-0032). MinIO/S3 migration is deferred to Phase 0.L (a destination swap, not a verb change).

observe.what: the shared NFS backup repository is mounted from nexus-gateway (192.168.70.1) -- the same mount on all 6 data nodes

steps.command: ssh -i $NEXUS_SSH_KEY nexusadmin@192.168.70.44 "clickhouse-client --secure --accept-invalid-certificate --host localhost --port 9440 --query \"BACKUP TABLE nexus.events_local TO Disk('analytics_backups', 'demo-backup.zip')\""

observe.what: a backup id + status BACKUP_CREATED -- the .zip is written to the shared NFS mount by shard1-rep1

steps.command: ssh -i $NEXUS_SSH_KEY nexusadmin@192.168.70.46 "clickhouse-client --secure --accept-invalid-certificate --host localhost --port 9440 --query \"RESTORE TABLE nexus.events_local AS nexus.events_demo_restore FROM Disk('analytics_backups', 'demo-backup.zip')\"; clickhouse-client --secure --accept-invalid-certificate --host localhost --port 9440 --query 'SELECT count() FROM nexus.events_demo_restore'"

observe.what: status RESTORED + a non-zero row count -- shard2-rep1 restored a backup TAKEN BY shard1-rep1, proving the repository is cluster-shared

steps.command: ssh -i $NEXUS_SSH_KEY nexusadmin@192.168.70.46 "clickhouse-client --secure --accept-invalid-certificate --host localhost --port 9440 --query 'DROP TABLE IF EXISTS nexus.events_demo_restore SYNC'"

whatProves: backup/restore round-trips through a genuinely cluster-shared repository (NFS from nexus-gateway): a backup taken on one node restores on another. ADR-0032 -- the destination swaps to MinIO/S3 at 0.L without changing the verb surface.
